[Beat 1 · setup]
Yuha sits by the shoe rack in the hallway. She pulls on her red shoe with a tug. "Mom gave me a tulip," Yuha says. She tucks the tulip into her pocket with a pat. Choroki pokes his green head toward the pocket. He sniffs, sniff, sniff. What is that sweet smell?

[Beat 2 · want]
Yuha runs out to the little garden. The sun is warm on her cheeks. She spots one red tomato among the leaves. "Come with me, Choroki!" Yuha calls. A ladybug sits on the stem tip and spins around, around. Yuha picks the tomato, slowly, slowly, and rolls it onto her palm. Choroki licks his lips. Will one tomato be enough?

[Beat 3 · attempt]
Yuha picks one, two, three tomatoes and hugs them to her chest. She climbs the windy hill, step by step. "Almost there, Choroki!" Yuha puffs. Whoosh! The wind snatches her yellow hat away. One, two, three, the tomatoes go tumbling down the hill. Choroki stares as the hat flies up and away. Thump, bump, roll!

[Beat 4 · attempt]
Yuha picks the tomatoes up again, one, two, three, four, five. She bundles them all in her shirt. Then she climbs the steep stone steps, huff, puff, huff. Behind her, Choroki sneaks a tomato and munches, crunch, crunch. "Hic!" Choroki hiccups, and his tail wiggles. Yuha's shirt rips with a loud rrrip! One, two, three, four, five, the tomatoes go tumbling down the steps. Where will they land?

[Beat 5 · turn]
Yuha flops down on the soft playroom mat. Her arms hang loose and her cheeks are red. She stares at the pile of tomatoes. "Too many," Yuha says with a sigh. She pulls the tulip from her pocket and shakes it, swish, swish. A ladybug flutters down and lands on the petal with a hop! Where did it come from?

[Beat 6 · resolution]
The ladybug taps one tomato, tap, tap, tap. "Oh, one at a time!" Yuha says, and she sorts the tomatoes into small piles. Choroki hiccups, "Hic, thump, hic, thump!" His song makes a beat. Yuha sways and wiggles as she walks. One, two, three, the tomatoes go hic, thump! She hands tomatoes to her friends in the sandbox. Everyone claps along!

[Beat 7 · close]
Ding-dong, ding-dong, the going-home bell rings. Yuha lifts the ladybug on the tulip and sets it gently back in the garden. "Bye-bye, little friend," Yuha whispers. Then she walks to the hallway by the shoe rack. She holds the tulip in her empty hand. Choroki hums, hic, hic, hic, all the way home.

Yuha sits in the sunny living room. She tries on one yellow boot. Then she slips it off by the blanket tunnel. "Come on, Choroki, let's go in!" Yuha calls. [Beat 2 · want]
Yuha holds Choroki's hand tight. "Where did the tunnel key go? Let's go and look!" she says. A snail slides slowly past the sunny window on the balcony. "The key is far away," the snail whispers in a slow voice. Yuha taps her chin and thinks. "Is it in the ...? Is it in the ...?" she asks. Yuha and Choroki will ask every place, one by one. Where will they look first?

[Beat 3 · attempt]
Yuha and Choroki tiptoe behind the soft sofa. Yuha climbs the tall ladder, one step, two steps. Choroki follows her, step by step, with a slow hum. "Open, tunnel, open!" Yuha shouts from the top. Her voice bounces off the ceiling. The tunnel door does not open, for it opens below, in the gap between the blankets. Is the key up on the tall ladder? No, there is no key here! Then a tiny jingle drifts in from far away.

[Beat 4 · attempt]
Yuha and Choroki tiptoe to the whispering reeds by the shoe shelf. The reeds go whisper, whisper, whisper. "Listen, I hear a jingle!" Yuha says. The key goes ding-ding, ding-ding, somewhere close. Then the wind goes whoosh, and the reeds rustle loud. The loud rustle covers the jingle, and Yuha cannot hear it. Choroki munches a sweet reed berry, yum, yum, yum. Is the key in the whispering reeds? No, there is no key here! Yuha pulls Choroki's hand, because a white mist is waiting ahead.

[Beat 5 · attempt]
Yuha and Choroki walk into a field of soft white fog. "Shh!" Yuha says, with a finger on her lips. Something shaped like a door handle shines in the fog. Yuha runs to it, but it is only a shadow in the fog. Then Choroki spots two stones that look just the same. Yuha and Choroki swap the stones with a giggle. "This stone is not the stone from before!" [Beat 6 · turn]
Yuha sits in the fog and looks at her bare toes. "Oh, my boot!" she says. She remembers the yellow boot by the tunnel. Yuha and Choroki dash back to the living room. The yellow boot sits by the blanket tunnel, right where she left it. Is the key in the boot? Yes, the key is here! It twinkles inside the boot, shiny and small.

[Beat 7 · resolution]
Yuha picks up the key and fits it into the blanket gap. The tunnel opens with a soft swish. "We did it, Choroki!" Yuha cheers. Yuha and Choroki crawl through the warm tunnel. [Beat 8 · close]
Evening comes, and the lamp glows soft and warm. Yuha hears Mom call her name from the kitchen. "Yuha, time to come in!" Mom says. Yuha puts the yellow boot by the door, next to its pair. Behind her, the old lighthouse keeper said, "I'll go light the lamp." The keeper climbed the hill toward the white lighthouse and was gone. Yuha knew the cold sea was only for grown-ups to enter, so she and Choroki stayed on the sand and waited.

[Beat 2 · want] Yuha stamped her feet, thump, thump, thump on the sand. "Hurry up, lamp!" she called. Choroki sat down slowly beside the black stone wall and peeled a sweet orange. Yuha cupped her hands around her mouth and shouted, "Let's go together!" Over the wall, a voice shouted back, "Let's go together!" Yuha's eyes grew round, and she thought, "Someone is over there!"

[Beat 3 · attempt] Yuha ran to the sand hill to find her new friend. Her feet sank, flump, flump, flump, with every step. She had almost reached the top when a seagull swooped down and cried, "Kree!" Yuha jumped, slipped, and slid all the way down on her bottom! Then she stood up and shouted, "Let's go together!" Over the wall, the voice answered louder, "Let's go together!"

[Beat 4 · attempt] Next, Yuha and Choroki walked through the sticky seed grass. Tiny seeds went tick, tick, tick onto her sleeves. Yuha kept her eyes down and brushed at them, and she did not see where her feet were going. Soon she reached a stone wall far from the lighthouse. Choroki rubbed his seedy belly and groaned, "I'm hungry." Then something boomed in the sky, "Rumble!" Yuha cried, "Thunder!" and hid behind the orange field wall. Choroki patted his round belly and chuckled, "That was my tummy. Time for oranges!"

[Beat 5 · attempt] Yuha followed the voice to a narrow log bridge. It creaked, creak, creak, under her small feet. She looked across, but nobody stood on the other side. Yuha's shoulders drooped, and she whispered, "My friend is gone." Choroki split an orange slice in half and handed her one piece. They sat side by side and shared it without a word.

Her friend was not a friend at all, and the voice was her own echo!

[Beat 7 · resolution] Yuha and Choroki burst into giggles, hee-hee-hee! Just then, the white lighthouse lit up, and its bright beam swept across the dark sea. [Beat 1 · setup]
Yuha found a huge dandelion puff behind the sofa. She tucked it into her pocket with a soft pat. Choroki rubbed his round belly and smacked his lips. "I'm so hungry," Choroki sighed. "Come with me!" Yuha cried, and she dashed into the adventure tunnel. Who would be waiting at the other end?

[Beat 2 · want]
The tunnel ended in a narrow alley in Kyoto. A wind chime rang ting-a-ling above the doorway. Yuha peeked over a wall and saw a pond. Fish opened and closed their mouths in the water, blub, blub. "I want to feed them!" Yuha said. She picked up one grain of fish food under the eave and dropped it into her basket. Plink! The dandelion puff poked its head out of her pocket. Where would she find more?

[Beat 3 · attempt]
Yuha counted on her fingers. "One! Food under the eave," she said. Next she got some on a bench by the tea shop. Then she found a third grain beside a stone lantern. "One, two, three... food is gathered!" Yuha sang, and Choroki licked his lips. Three doors stood in a row, and all three looked the same. Yuha pushed the right door open a crack, and she could hear water splashing behind it. A big deer stepped in front of the door and would not move. Whoosh! A gust of wind snatched the hat off Yuha's head. The hat flew away and landed on a goat's head. The goat blinked and looked away as if nothing had happened. "Ha ha ha!" Yuha and Choroki laughed. Could the deer be coaxed away from the door?

[Beat 4 · attempt]
Yuha walked on and found four grains in the bamboo path. She found a fifth grain on the red bridge. Her basket grew heavier with every grain. "One, two, three, four, five... food is gathered!" Yuha groaned, and her arms drooped. Butterflies fluttered flap, flap, flap and covered her whole view. Ting-a-ling, ting-a-ling! A bell rang somewhere close by. "Where are you?" Yuha shouted, and her voice rang across the water. Splash! The fish all flicked their tails and dove deep into the pond. What would Yuha do now?

[Beat 5 · turn]
Yuha set the heavy basket down and sat with a plop. Her arms felt like soft noodles. The dandelion puff floated up out of her pocket, poof, poof. Ting-a-ling! A tiny cricket sat on the chime string and rang the bell with its wings. "So it was you!" Yuha whispered. The cricket hopped onto the puff and held on tight. Yuha took a slow breath and blew softly, whoo. The puff drifted out and landed lightly on the pond. Would the fish come back?

[Beat 6 · resolution]
One silver fish rose up to the puff, then another. Soon the whole pond was full of fish. "One, two, three... fish are gathered!" Yuha laughed. She sprinkled a small pinch of food from her basket, plip, plip. The fish munched blub, blub, blub. Choroki gobbled up the last few grains and patted his tummy. Then the deer walked over and sat down by the water.

[Beat 7 · close]
Ting-a-ling, ting-a-ling, ting-a-ling! The chime rang three times. "Time to go home!" Yuha said, and Choroki followed her into the tunnel. The cricket waved a tiny leg at them from its string. Yuha found a big dandelion puff. It was behind the sofa. She put it in her pocket. "I am hungry," said Choroki. "Come with me!" said Yuha.

[Beat 2 · want]
The tunnel led to a narrow alley. A wind chime went ting-a-ling. Yuha saw fish in a pond. "I want to feed them!" said Yuha. She picked up one fish food.

[Beat 3 · attempt]
"One! Food under the eave," counted Yuha. "Two! Food on the bench." "One, two, three... food is gathered!" sang Yuha. A big deer stood in front of the door. Whoosh! The wind blew Yuha's hat onto a goat. "Ha ha ha!" laughed Choroki.

[Beat 4 · attempt]
Yuha found more food on the red bridge. Her basket felt so heavy. "One, two, three, four, five... food is gathered!" groaned Yuha. Splash! The fish dove deep into the pond. "Where are you?" shouted Yuha.

[Beat 5 · turn]
Yuha sat down with a plop. The dandelion puff floated up, poof. A tiny cricket sat on the chime string. "So it was you!" whispered Yuha. Yuha blew softly, whoo. The puff floated onto the pond.

[Beat 6 · resolution]
One silver fish swam up to the puff. Soon the whole pond was full of fish. "One, two, three... fish are gathered!" laughed Yuha. The fish munched, blub, blub. Then the deer sat down by the water.

[Beat 7 · close]
Ting-a-ling! The chime rang three times. "Time to go home!" said Yuha. Back home, Yuha hugged her empty basket. Soon she was fast asleep.

[Beat 1 · setup] Yuha dug behind the living-room sofa and found a round fan. "Come on, Choroki, let's go together!" she called. Yuha and Choroki crawled through the adventure tunnel, and a glassy blue coral sea opened up before them. A clownfish popped out of the coral and waved its orange fin. Yuha giggled and waved right back!

[Beat 2 · want] Choroki's feet crunched across the white sand island. Yuha pointed up at the branches, where a koala was sleeping in the tree. "I can wake it, even with a voice as small as a mosquito!" Yuha whispered. Yuha tucked the fan into her waistband, snug and tight. Would the koala hear her?

[Beat 3 · attempt] Choroki puffed out his chest and shouted, "I'll call as loud as a boot! Boot-loud!" Yuha jumped on the swinging bridge and shouted, "I'll call even louder, as loud as a balloon!" The two friends yelled until the bridge wobbled, wibble-wobble, wibble-wobble. The koala only snored, zzz, zzz, zzz. Yuha frowned at the branch. The koala had not moved at all!

[Beat 4 · attempt] Choroki's tummy rumbled, grumble-gurgle, loud as a drum. "A koala will wake up for a yummy smell, won't it?" Yuha asked. The friends hurried to the stinky fish market. "I'll call as loud as a whale!" Yuha shouted, holding her nose. Yuha sniffed and groaned, "Ew, ew!" Fish baskets lay all around, but no koala was there. Where had the koala gone?

[Beat 5 · attempt] Rain began to fall, pitter-patter, pitter-patter on the ground. Yuha tipped her head back and stuck out her tongue to catch the drops. A raindrop missed her tongue and plopped, tok, right on her nose! "Hee-hee, it tickles!" Yuha laughed. Yuha and Choroki ran into the tickly grass. "I'll call as loud as the sky!" Yuha shouted. The grass tickled their noses, and they both sneezed, "Ah-choo!" Up in the tree, the koala dug deeper into its blanket.

[Beat 6 · turn] Yuha sat down under the tree, and she did not make a sound. A huge shadow, soft as moonlight, wobbled across the branches. Yuha pulled the fan from her waistband and opened it wide. Yuha fanned it gently, swish-swish, swish-swish. The big shadow shrank and shrank until it became the shadow of a tiny baby koala!

[Beat 7 · resolution] The soft fan breeze tickled the baby koala's fuzzy ears. The baby koala yawned wide and opened its sleepy eyes. Yuha rubbed her own eyes and murmured, "I called as softly as a fan breeze." Choroki sat down beside the baby koala, side by side.

[Beat 8 · close] Far away, a ship's horn tooted, whoo-oo! Yuha and Choroki waved goodbye to the baby koala. The two friends hurried back through the adventure tunnel to the sofa. Yuha hugged the fan and curled up on the soft cushions. "I'm as sleepy as a koala yawn," Choroki whispered.

[Beat 1 · setup]
Yuha rolls the mat up in the living room. She slings it over her shoulder and calls, "Come with me, Choroki!" Choroki follows her behind the sofa, and the two of them crawl into the adventure tunnel. At the far end, Yuha sees terraced fields under a peak with a cloud snagged on top. Cool mountain air smells of wet grass.

[Beat 2 · want]
Yuha spreads the mat beside a stone-wall path and sits down on it. Then a thin sound drifts across the fields. "Peek!" Yuha looks down at her feet and laughs, because her rain boots do not match. When she stands, one boot goes thump and the other goes tap, and Yuha jumps at the noise. "I will find who makes that sound!" she says. Choroki rubs his round tummy and hops up beside her. "Peek, peeek!" the sound calls from far away.

[Beat 3 · attempt]
Yuha tilts her head, and the sound seems to float from the swinging bridge. "Come with me!" she tells Choroki, and she steps onto the planks. The bridge wobbles and creaks, so Yuha walks slowly and holds the rope tight. At the other end, a crowd of alpacas rushes up, and their soft wool blocks the whole path. A condor spreads his huge wings and glides over the bridge with a whoosh. Where did the sound go?

[Beat 4 · attempt]
"Peeeek!" the sound sings again, and this time it seems to come from the honey tree. Yuha shakes the trunk very gently, hoping the tree will peep. Instead, a loud buzz fills the air, and the bees zoom round and round. A drop of honey falls onto a leaf, and Choroki licks it up. "This is a sweet sound," Choroki says with a grin. "Peek, peeek!" the real sound calls again, farther off.

[Beat 5 · attempt]
"Peeeeek!" the sound grows loud, then soft, then loud again. Yuha tiptoes to the alpaca pen and peers between the fence boards. The alpacas open their mouths, and out comes only "Baaa!" Yuha scratches her head and sighs. Then a round fruit rolls bumpety-bump across the dirt and stops right in front of her boot. Where did that fruit come from?

[Beat 6 · turn]
Yuha and Choroki climb to the very top of the terraced fields, tired and slow. The mat they left behind is lifting a little in the wind, and a thin sound leaks out from under it. "Peek!" Yuha tiptoes over, lifts one corner of the mat with both hands, and gasps. Ants have lined up reed pieces side by side, from short to long. Little birds have swept the reeds with their tail feathers to make a path for the wind. "The sound was right here all along!" Yuha cries.

[Beat 7 · resolution]
Yuha holds the reed pipes steady with both hands. She takes a deep breath and blows, "Hooo." "Peek, peeek, peeeek!" The sound rolls long and warm across the terraced fields. Choroki sits down close to Yuha, and his shoulder bumps hers. "Let's play it together," Choroki says. Yuha smiles and lifts the pipes again.

[Beat 8 · close]
The pipe song floats over the village. Then the very same song floats back from the tunnel. Yuha and Choroki roll up the mat and carry it on their shoulders. They crawl through the tunnel and come out behind the sofa. Yuha spreads the mat beside her bed and lies down on it. "Sleep with me," she whispers, and Choroki curls up beside her.

비가 오는 들판에서 짚신이 벗겨졌고, 동굴에서 자고 일어나니 짚신 그림자가 커져 있었어요.

en.rich:
[Beat 1 · setup] Behind the sofa, a dark tunnel waited. Yuha found an old straw shoe there. She slipped her foot inside and wiggled her toes. "Let's go together!" Yuha shouted, and she grabbed Choroki's hand. The two of them dashed into the tunnel, and the air smelled like smoke!

[Beat 2 · want] A bonfire crackled beside a wall covered with handprints. Yuha lifted her straw shoe high, and a shadow jumped onto the wall. "My shadow is as big as cotton candy!" she cried. Choroki puffed out his round belly, and his shadow bulged like a melon. "Mine is bigger," Choroki said with a yawn. Yuha tiptoed toward the bonfire, and the fire popped loudly.

[Beat 3 · attempt] The stepping-stones wobbled over the rushing creek. Yuha spread both arms wide on the stone. "I am as big as a boot!" she called. Her shadow stretched long across the water, and the creek went splish, splash. Yuha hopped to the very last stone. It rocked, and her straw shoe flew off! Her long shadow snapped in two, and the creek swallowed it. Then a tiny light blinked ahead.

[Beat 4 · attempt] Fireflies twinkled all through the next tunnel. Yuha stood in the middle of the glowing dots. "I am as big as a soap bubble!" she shouted, and she waved her arms. The lights shone from every side, so her shadow split into many thin streaks. Choroki munched a nut and stared at them. Just then, a mole poked his nose out of the dirt. He tilted his head, and the dirt went plop.

[Beat 5 · attempt] A hairy mammoth field stretched out under dark clouds. Yuha climbed onto a big gray rock. "I am as big as the sky!" she yelled. Rain pounded down, drip, drop, drip, drop! No fire burned there, and no shadow appeared. Yuha leaped into the puddles, splash, splash. Her wet shoe slid off, and she raced away in her socks. Her socks went squish, squish, squish!

[Beat 6 · turn] The bonfire shrank to a tiny glow, so Yuha slogged back to the cave. Her wet socks dripped on the floor. She sat on the stone chair beside the fire. Then she set her soggy shoe next to the flames, nice and neat. Yuha rubbed her eyes with both fists. "I am... sleepy..." she mumbled. Orange sparks floated up, and the shoe began to steam.

[Beat 7 · resolution] Yuha fell asleep, and the bonfire kept on glowing. All night long, the flames made the shoe's shadow grow on the wall. Morning light came, and Yuha opened her eyes. A giant shoe shadow covered the whole wall! "Wow, my shoe grew this big!" she cried with a laugh. Choroki hopped up beside her, and the mole peeked out too. Yuha and Choroki waved their arms and legs. They danced in front of the giant shadow, stomp, stomp, swish!

[Beat 8 · close] The bonfire shrank again, so Yuha put on her straw shoe. She crawled back through the tunnel and out behind the sofa. The living room felt warm and quiet. Choroki leaned close and whispered, "My shadow is as big as the cave." Yuha hugged the straw shoe to her chest, and she slowly drifted off to sleep.
